verdict.rationale: Deel documents end-to-end handling as its core service. It says it handles 'every step of the process—from preparing your application', and that in-house experts file forms. It also frames career achievements to meet 'Highly Skilled' criteria for O-1 and similar petitions, which it offers to founders. Assembling the evidence binder and drafting expert and support letters are never explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit evidence-binder assembly, expert/recommendation and support letter drafting, independent or hands-on corroboration of petition preparation.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service

citations.quote: we handle every step of the process—from preparing your application to organizing consulate appointments—so you can focus on your project, not the paperwork.
Our in-house experts file forms, organize your consulate appointments, and provide specific preparation for your visa interview.
we frame your career achievements to meet specific "Highly Skilled" criteria worldwide.
We have the immigration experience and know-how to help founders secure the right visa or green card for them.
